fusions.name: Rooftop Pounce
fusions.desc: Pounces on a target up to 6 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from full range. It is always a critical hit, and the target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Batting Paws
fusions.desc: Bats at everything in reach with both hands, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 35% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Always Lands
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 6 seconds, and you finish 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Soft-Footed Luck
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that got past your dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
